context:
Goal: an Explore agent never writes a file.
Problem (rule): the lane says close, because main's guard readonly-shell-write already stops the named mistake. But that guard judges only redirect, tee, touch and mktemp; a brief ordering a write by cp, sed -i or python -c still passes on main. Closing also closes #2693.
Based on (code): guard readonly-shell-write, hooks/guard.py.
Departs from: main — main has no spawn-time check on the brief; this adds one.

options.gain: Catches writes by cp, sed -i and python -c.

options.lose: Two more PRs stay open in the drain.
